content:
A positive correlation between adult age and herbal tea consumption means that as age increases, tea consumption also tends to increase.  
This does not imply causation in either direction (so A and B are unsupported causal claims).  
It also does not support the idea that older adults drink less herbal tea (C is opposite to the finding).  
The only direct descriptive conclusion from the correlation is that older adults drink more herbal tea than younger adults (D).  

Final answer: (D)
